edges.reason: releasedBalance() computes the vested amount from the miner-controlled block.timestamp, creating a timestamp dependency.
terminate() rewrites _releaseEndTime using block.timestamp, so the vesting result depends on miner-controlled time.
The constructor validates _releaseEndTime against block.timestamp, tying initialization to miner-controlled time.
releasedBalance() reads _releaseStartTime to compute elapsed days.
releasedBalance() reads _releaseEndTime to bound the vesting window.
releasedBalance() scales _totalBenefit by the elapsed fraction of the window.
unreleasedBalance() subtracts releasedBalance() from _totalBenefit.
withdraw() requires releasedBalance() > _withdrawedBalance before transferring tokens.
withdraw() reads and increments _withdrawedBalance to track payouts.
terminate() resets _totalBenefit to the current releasedBalance().
terminate() overwrites _totalBenefit with the released balance.
terminate() rewrites _releaseEndTime to the start of the current day.
isNotTerminated modifier reads _isTerminated to gate execution.
isNotTerminated modifier guards terminate() against repeated termination.
onlyOwner modifier restricts terminate() to the contract owner.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender with the stored owner, making the caller the access-control input.
onlyOwner reads _owner to validate the caller.
owner() returns the _owner state variable.
_setOwner() reads and writes _owner.
renounceOwnership() calls _setOwner(address(0)).
transferOwnership() calls _setOwner(newOwner).
onlyOwner modifier restricts renounceOwnership() to the owner.
onlyOwner modifier restricts transferOwnership() to the owner.
withdraw() uses the stored _token contract to transfer funds.
terminate() uses the stored _token contract to transfer funds.
withdraw() transfers the released amount to the stored _beneficiary.
withdraw() reaches an external token transfer via safeTransfer, exposing state after the call boundary.
terminate() reaches an external token transfer via safeTransfer inside an onlyOwner flow.
A malicious token implementation could re-enter withdraw() during safeTransfer before state is settled.
A malicious token implementation could re-enter terminate() during safeTransfer before _isTerminated is set.
token() returns the _token state variable.
beneficiary() returns the _beneficiary state variable.
totalBenefit() returns the _totalBenefit state variable.
withdrawedBalance() returns the _withdrawedBalance state variable.
withdraw() queries the external token balance before transferring.
terminate() queries the external token balance to compute the owner payout.
Constructor parameter token_ initializes the _token immutable.
Constructor parameter beneficiary_ initializes the _beneficiary immutable.
Constructor parameter releaseStartTime_ initializes _releaseStartTime and _releaseEndTime.
Constructor parameter daysOfTimelock_ scales the release end time.
Constructor parameter totalBenefit_ initializes _totalBenefit.
transferOwnership parameter newOwner is forwarded to _setOwner.
Local amount holds the newly released delta transferred in withdraw().
Local amountToWithdraw holds the owner payout computed in terminate().
Local oldOwner caches the previous owner inside _setOwner.
Local passedDays holds the elapsed days used in releasedBalance().
Local totalDays holds the window length used in releasedBalance().

normalization_plan.reason: token_ is a constructor-only parameter that initializes the _token immutable and has no standalone behavior.
beneficiary_ is a constructor-only parameter that initializes the _beneficiary immutable.
releaseStartTime_ is a constructor-only parameter that defines the vesting window start.
daysOfTimelock_ is a constructor-only parameter used to derive _releaseEndTime.
totalBenefit_ is a constructor-only parameter that initializes _totalBenefit.
newOwner is the input of transferOwnership and is passed directly into _setOwner.
amount is a transient local computed and spent within withdraw().
amountToWithdraw is a transient local computed and spent within terminate().
oldOwner is a transient local used only for the ownership event inside _setOwner.
passedDays is an intermediate value used only to compute releasedBalance().
totalDays is an intermediate value used only to compute releasedBalance().
